messages:
ci-bot: [CI] pipeline failed on job `unit-tests-runtime` (agent-7)
ci-bot: failing test: runtime::serve::tests::retry_backoff_respects_max_retries (flake)
elaine: Ugh, saw this in last PR too. Repro rate ~1/60 in CI. @vikram any idea? :thinking_face:
vikram: I have a hunch it's scheduler jitter + our test's timing windows. The failure trace shows an assert in heap manager after a retry: we sometimes enqueue an extra timer wake.
ryan: Can you paste the relevant logs? I can try a local stress run.
vikram: Sure — here's the snippet from the failing CI run:
```
thread 'runtime::serve::tests::retry_backoff_respects_max_retries' panicked at 'assertion failed: heap.peek().deadline >= now', src/runtime/serve/retry.rs:214:9
stack backtrace:
  0: retry::schedule_timer
  1: serve::session::on_retry
  2: test::run
  ...
```
samir: Noticed the same pattern earlier when running with -Ztokio-coop. The test assumes no two timers are scheduled for the same session in the same tick.
elaine: So nondeterministic ordering of timer callbacks.
vikram: Exact. Locally I can reproduce at ~1/400 with `cargo test --test serve_tests -- --nocapture --ignored --exact retry_backoff_respects_max_retries` if I export RUNTIME_TEST_SEED=12345 and run 200 iterations.
ryan: Ok I'll try the seed run. If it's seed-dependent we can bisect.
marta: Could we instead make the test not rely on strict ordering? Quick patch: allow coalesced wakeups by checking a <= instead of < in the assertion. That would be safer short-term.
vikram: Maybe, but that masks the underlying scheduler issue. I prefer adding a deterministic clock to the test harness so it advances in controlled steps.
elaine: For immediate CI stability, add a flaky skip label or mark as flaky to reduce noise? We have PRs blocked.
samir: I can enqueue a manual rerun on the failing job now: `ci-bot rerun 1719902468 unit-tests-runtime` — will follow up with logs.
ci-bot: Request accepted. Manual rerun queued on agent-3.
ryan: While rerun is running — @vikram please create a small reproducer harness in /devtools/serve-flake-repro so SREs can run it under stress.
vikram: Will do. I'll include env vars: RUNTIME_TEST_SEED, RUNTIME_CLOCK=deterministic, and a small script to iterate 1000x.
elaine: If rerun comes back green, let's still open a tracking ticket and assign owners. This keeps CI clean but we don't lose the bug.
marta: Agreed. I can make the JIRA: INF-2148 "intermittent retry_backoff heap ordering" and add steps to reproduce + suggested mitigations.
samir: Rerun finished — attached log: one failure again. Pushing logs to gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood-internal/abc123 (contains full backtrace + env dump)
ryan: I pulled the gist. The failure includes `tokio::time::advance` not being honored sometimes under heavy scheduling. Reproduced locally with `--test-threads=1` disabled.
vikram: Action items I'll take: 1) small repro harness in /devtools; 2) attempt deterministic-clock test rewrite; 3) run seed-sweep to find minimal seed and bisect if needed.
elaine: Marta will file tracker, Samir will keep CI reruns as needed, Ryan will run stress locally and post results here. I'll notify product if this might affect canary workloads.
marta: JIRA created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2148 — assigned to @vikram, priority P2. Notes: skip-on-flaky temporarily blocked until root cause identified.
samir: Leaving a comment on the failing PR recommending `--nocapture --test-threads=1` as a temporary debug step for authors.
elaine: Thanks all. Ping here when the repro is in the repo or if you need CI capacity from eng-infra.
vikram: Uploaded repro: git+ssh://git@repo/redwood/devtools.git@serve-flake-repro, branch `repro/retry-backoff-heap-171990` — includes `run_repro.sh` and README.
ryan: Got it, running 10k iterations now locally, will report if I find deterministic seed. :eyes:
ci-bot: [CI] rerun #2 failed on agent-5 — same assertion. Logged as flaky. 
elaine: Ok plan: keep CI reruns enabled, don't block merges on this test for next 24h if green elsewhere, and get the deterministic-clock patch in a follow-up. Closing thread when we have repro + ticket updates.
vikram: Will update INF-2148 with repro results later tonight.
marta: Thanks. :thumbsup:
